placement.reason: LFM3 lineages, one per GPU sandbox (plans/neuralese/LFM3_RL_CLOUD_20261031.md): a joint-SFT lineage trains window after window from the earned DGX boundary; an RL lineage (JOLT+ or self-distillation) alternates its actor and learner as alt_par.sh does on DGX. Full state exports at every boundary (and periodically within an SFT window) to private W&B storage and the DGX hub (rl_cloud.py export).

resource_notes: Exactly one GPU, explicit CPU/RAM minima (owner 2026-10-29: learners 8 CPU / 64Gi; inference engines >= 8 CPU). The template default is the joint-SFT learner: DGX R38 window learner host RSS ~11-27 GB plus the 15 GB full-state checkpoint load. RL lineages (actor + 12-24 natlang node workers + learner; DGX-measured ~18 GB host while collecting) declare more in the run file's per-lineage "resources" (16 CPU / 96Gi). Replace with the measured cgroup peak (+25%) each call logs (call_done memory_peak). GPU: unconstrained; the learner's capacity qualification re-measures on the assigned GPU (DGX GB10 peaks ~64 GB CUDA). minimum_resources is the floor of the launch-time shape backoff (cwctl.create_with_shape_backoff, owner 2026-11-03): SandboxResourceExhausted lowers CPU/RAM stepwise toward it, always exactly one GPU; 48Gi covers the 15 GB checkpoint load plus the measured ~11-27 GB learner RSS.
bundle_plan: rl_cloud.py seed RUN.json LINEAGE (window 0, input closure, parent ZIP delta), rl_cloud.py bundle RUN.json (code snapshot, wheelhouse, HF base; RL: custody packets, task source, SGLang fork only when used); rl_cloud.py launch RUN.json LINEAGE pushes the bundle and the rl-parent capability.
